CustomField.description: When true, articles without data categories are scored as a Completeness issue. When false, missing categories are informational only. Reflects whether data categories are part of the org's Knowledge governance (visibility, scoped retrieval), not a property of any specific retriever.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on if your Knowledge implementation uses data categories. When on, articles without a category will be flagged as incomplete. When off, missing categories are noted but not penalised.
CustomField.label: Do you use data categories
